$comment: Plugin defaults (layer 1). Override in a team file (DISPATCH_TEAM_CONFIG or <plugin>/config/team.json), project .dispatch/config.json, then ~/.dispatch/config.json. Keys listed in `locked` by a layer cannot be changed by later layers.

budgets.$comment: Weighted tokens per run size (placeholders until evals tune them).

weights.$comment: Tier weight applied to tokens for budgets; sonnet = 1.

prices.$comment: USD per 1M tokens, Anthropic first-party API rates (claude-api skill, cached 2026-11-03). Cache write assumed 1.25x input; Haiku cache read assumed 0.1x input. Used only for a $ equivalent.

outward.$comment: During a run, MCP tools are outward (operator-only, approval required) unless their tool-name suffix matches a read pattern.

destinations.$comment: Empty = any destination the user approves. Otherwise a list of regexes matched against an action's target.

data.$comment: When false, researcher agents (web access) must not be given content from internal connectors.
